A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the saturation of colour samples affects both unique hue and category prototype judgements.

The main takeaway from our work is that
when measuring colour categorisation or unique hue, the saturation of the stimulus set should be kept as constant as possible across hue, or else the results will depend on this variation.
saturation is a critical variable in the measurement of colour perception and that it should not be ignored.
saturation is an important variable that must be taken into account when investigating colour categorisation and unique hue perception.
